tha-ap518:1.1: Ajjunapupphiya.] Candabhāgā-nadītīre ahosiṃ kinnaro tadā / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ sayambhuṃ aparājitaṃ. // //
tha-ap518:2.1: Pasannacitto sumano vedajāto katañjalī / gahetvā ajjunaṃ pupphaṃ sayambhuṃ abhipūjayiṃ. // //
tha-ap518:3.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā kinnaraṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap518:4.1: Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ. / dasakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti mahārajjam akārayiṃ // //
tha-ap518:5.1: Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ / sukhette va phītaṃ bījaṃ sayambhusmiṃ aho mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap518:6.1: Kusalaṃ vijjate mayhaṃ pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ / pūjāraho ahaṃ ajja Sakyaputtassa sāsane.
tha-ap518:10.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ajjunapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
